snippet.title: GTA 5 Characters Saying Goodbye to You Before GTA 6 | Tribute
snippet.description:
Goodbye, GTA 5. After 13 years, Franklin, Michael and Trevor say goodbye to you before GTA 6: one last ride through Los Santos, one last call, and one last goodbye.

It's 11:20 PM on November 18th. GTA 6 unlocks in forty minutes. But before you go, there are three men in Los Santos you have to say goodbye to. You were twelve when your brother handed you the controller. You grew up with them: the cheat codes on a math notebook, Lamar's roast, the heists that failed eleven times, the friends list that slowly went quiet. Tonight you load GTA 5 one last time. Franklin, Michael and Trevor each say goodbye in their own way, Lester, Jimmy and Ron call one last time, and at the end of the pier Jason and Lucia are waiting to take you to Vice City.

This is our tribute to GTA V before GTA VI: goodbye GTA 5, hello GTA 6. Who handed you the controller for the first time? Tell them tonight, and tell me in the comments.

CHAPTERS

0:25 Grand Theft Auto V

6:20 Trevor
